overview: The e-RUPI scheme is a digital payment solution launched by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) to enable contactless, cashless transactions through a QR code or SMS-based string. It is designed as a pre-paid, purpose-specific voucher system that ensures targeted delivery of benefits without the need for a bank account, digital wallet, or app. The scheme supports financial inclusion by allowing beneficiaries to redeem services at mapped merchant locations using a unique e-RUPI code.
objectives: Enable contactless and cashless digital transactions
Ensure targeted delivery of welfare services without leakage
Promote financial inclusion for unbanked populations
Reduce dependency on physical vouchers or cash
Support seamless redemption at merchant locations
Strengthen the digital payments ecosystem in India
eligibility: Beneficiaries identified by government or corporate sponsors for specific welfare or promotional schemes; no bank account, smartphone, or internet required to receive or use e-RUPI.
benefits: Contactless redemption via QR code or SMS; no need for bank account, digital wallet, or app; ensures purpose-specific usage; real-time tracking by sponsors; zero transaction cost to beneficiary; supports offline redemption at mapped merchant locations.
financial_support: e-RUPI is a pre-paid voucher system where the sponsoring entity (government or corporate) loads funds onto the voucher; the beneficiary receives no direct cash but can redeem the voucher for specified goods or services at designated merchants; the financial value is determined by the sponsor and transferred to the merchant upon successful redemption.
application_process: 1. Government or corporate sponsor approaches NPCI or its authorized partner to issue e-RUPI vouchers. 2. Sponsor provides beneficiary details (name, mobile number) and purpose/amount of voucher. 3. NPCI generates a unique e-RUPI QR code or SMS string. 4. Sponsor distributes the e-RUPI to beneficiary via SMS or messaging platform. 5. Beneficiary shows the QR code or shares the SMS string at merchant point-of-sale. 6. Merchant validates the e-RUPI through their acquiring bank or PSP. 7. Upon validation, merchant provides the service/goods and settles the amount with NPCI.
deadlines: Rolling basis — issued as per sponsor requirement
caveats: e-RUPI is valid only for the specific purpose and merchant(s) mapped by the sponsor
Voucher expires if not redeemed within the validity period set by the sponsor
Cannot be transferred to another person or used for cash withdrawal
Requires merchant to be onboarded with a participating acquirer bank or PSP
